welcomeDescription:
**<:MemberJoin:1087453129198546964> Welcome Messages**

> `{0}welcome channel set <#channel>`
> `{0}welcome channel remove`
> `{0}welcome message <message>`
> `{0}welcome picture set <picture>`
> `{0}welcome picture remove`
> `{0}welcome picture show`

> Variables for welcome message are `{{user_mention}}`, `{{user_name}}`, `{{user_discriminator}}`, `{{guild_name}}`, `{{guild_membercount}}`
> You can create a welcome message with multiple lines using `\n`
> To completely remove the welcome message, add `_ _` as the message
